thread:
elena: Heads up — customer reports Viewer was able to open Project > API keys modal and copy the full key (not just masked). Can reproduce in staging. Steps:
1) log in as user with Viewer role
2) nav to Project -> API keys
3) click the row -> 'Show' (should be blocked)

Screenshot: https://redwood.screens/abcd

Logs show the authorizer returned `allow` for `view_api_keys` due to a session cache hit. snippet:
```
[auth] user=U-12345 action=view_api_keys result=allow source=session-cache roles:viewer
```

Can someone triage? This feels like a server-side gating miss or cache staleness.

ben: On it. Reproduced locally. Quick look: role-change TTL vs session cache seems off after the recent auth refactor. Will dig into the middleware.

sasha: I can reproduce on staging too. User id U-12345, org 67890. Backend stack trace shows `keys_controller#show` didn't call `authorize!` after refactor. Patch incoming. Minimal repro curl:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.com/projects/67890/keys/abcd
# returns 200 + plaintext key
```

ingrid_prodsec: Important: is KMS involved here? If viewers can copy keys we need to rotate affected keys immediately. Do we know if the key was plaintext in the DB or decrypted on the fly via KMS?

ben: It's decrypted server-side via GCP KMS. The endpoint returns plaintext because the permission check was skipped. So KMS itself not compromised, but the revealed key should be rotated. Looking at commits, PR #3487 moved some checks to auth-proxy but missed the keys controller check during the refactor.

elena: Audit logs show 4 accesses to that keys.show endpoint from the org in the last hour. I triggered an alert. Action items: (1) block endpoint in prod if possible (2) rotate affected API key in KMS (3) invalidate sessions for that org (4) hotfix to add server-side RBAC check + cache invalidation.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: started hotfix deploy to staging (commit abc123) :rocket:

ben: Hotfix adds explicit `authorize! :view_api_keys` into `keys_controller#show` and exposes an admin API to invalidate session cache for an org. Pushing tests now. Will plan prod deploy after smoke tests, target +15m.

sasha: Also adding an automated regression test that calls the endpoint as Viewer to ensure 403. Note: auth-proxy has session-affinity caching keyed by `roles:v1`. We should emit a role-change event to the cache on role updates; otherwise a downgraded user keeps previous claims until TTL expires.

oncall-ops: Created INC-2026-0421 and notified the customer. Support has been CC'd with a 'rotate keys' recommendation.

ingrid_prodsec: KMS rotation queued for key ring `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/api-keys`. Starting rotation now, ETA ~20m. Will update audit and provide rotation job id.

elena: Good. Also assign postmortem owner and include timeline of the refactor checklist miss. Who can own the postmortem?

ben: I'll own the postmortem and put an initial draft in #postmortems. Short term: rolling to prod in 20 after staging pass. If any regression, we'll rollback.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: staging smoke passed. beginning prod deploy (commit abc123) :boom:

sasha: Confirmed regression test added + CI green. Also opened an auth-proxy follow-up to add event-driven cache invalidation on role update.

elena: Thanks all — follow ups tracked in INC-2026-0421. Please post timestamps for KMS rotation and session invalidation here when done. :clap:
